en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5663 - Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd narrated from Al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:

He asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a boy being married to a girl - do they inherit from one another?
Imam (as) said: "If it was their parents who arranged their marriage, then yes, they do inherit from each other."
